name: HUMIDIFIER
desc: Fully Automatic Large-Capacity Ultrasonic Humidifier engineered to optimize micro-climates in greenhouse and horticultural environments. Features a 13-liter tank delivering 6 liters/hour mist output, driven by an energy-efficient 500W ultrasonic transducer.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS HUMIDIFIER operates on high-frequency ultrasonic piezoelectric transduction to generate a dense, ultra-fine cool mist without thermal input, enabling precise micro-climate control in commercial greenhouses, botanical nurseries, and horticultural research facilities. The integrated 500 W ultrasonic transducer oscillates at high frequency to atomize water into droplets typically below 5 µm, which rapidly evaporate to raise relative humidity while maintaining near-ambient temperature. Built-in digital Relative Humidity (RH) sensors continuously monitor the environment and feed signals to an intelligent PID controller, which modulates mist output to maintain a user-defined setpoint with minimal hysteresis. This system supports cultivation of humidity-sensitive plant species, orchid and fern micro-propagation, fungal and microbial culture chambers, and plant physiology experiments conducted by B.Sc/M.Sc students, PhD researchers, and agricultural scientists. It also aids in maintaining stable humidity for seed germination assays, Arabidopsis thaliana growth rooms, and entomology rearing chambers, while supporting compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and ISO 9001 environmental monitoring protocols. The corrosion-proof, weather-resistant enclosure and dual-outlet distribution network ensure uniform coverage up to 500 sq ft, making it suitable for long-term botanical and horticultural studies requiring stable, contamination-free humidification.
sop: Place the humidifier on a level, vibration-free surface near a dedicated 230 V AC, 50 Hz single-phase outlet and fill the 13-liter reservoir with clean distilled or deionized water up to the maximum level mark.
Connect the power cord and switch ON the main isolator; verify that the digital RH controller illuminates and displays the current chamber or greenhouse relative humidity.
Press the 'SET' button once to enter the target relative humidity setpoint mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter, such as 80% RH for orchid micro-propagation or 65% RH for general plant growth.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value; the PID controller will automatically engage the ultrasonic transducer when measured RH falls below the setpoint and stop misting when the setpoint is reached.
Direct the dual mist outlets toward the crop canopy, culture shelves, or target zone, ensuring no obstruction within the 500 sq ft coverage area for uniform distribution.
Monitor the water level during operation and refill before it drops below the minimum mark to prevent dry running of the ultrasonic transducer.
At the end of daily use, switch OFF the unit, drain residual water, wipe the tank with a mild disinfectant, and leave the lid open to prevent microbial biofilm formation.

Safety Warning: Never operate the humidifier with hard tap water, strong acids, VOCs, fertilizers, or any chemical additives in the reservoir, as ultrasonic nebulization can aerosolize hazardous residues and damage the transducer; always disconnect power before cleaning or maintenance.
